caption_L1: This is a bar chart titled Number of students who graduated from postsecondary institutions in South Africa in 2015 , by race and field of study. The x-axis measures field of study using a categorical scale from Agriculture, Agricultural Operations and Related Sciences to Visual and Performing Arts. A linear scale from 0 to 3,500 can be found along the y-axis, labeled Coloured.
caption_L2L3: Business and economics was the most popular area of study. Education was second. There were no students studying the military. Only three subjects had more than 1000 students.
